def objects_by_rows(g, bg):
    from collections import Counter
    # split grid into horizontal bands separated by all-background rows
    objs=[]; cur=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        if all(x==bg for x in row):
            if cur: objs.append(cur); cur=[]
